Area.evidence_source: In contrast to unforeseen cases, other participants rationalized the suicide based on understandings that the deceased had significant contributing circumstances and/or risk factors. Among these cases were men who had been receiving professional mental health care leading up to the suicide. For example, a middle-aged participant whose father shot himself with a rifle explained that his dad had had a long history of severe depression and began taking antidepressant medications 5 days prior to his death. Another participant explained that his friend, who slit his wrists in the bathtub, had been diagnosed with bipolar disorder and was taking medication for a major depressive episode at the time of his death.; I'm not angry with him. In fact, I think I was a bit relieved for him, that his suffering was over . . . I think about him being alive and still struggling . . . I just thought, "He's free, finally he's free" . . . I think that people value themselves and have self-esteem when they can take care of themselves. He was rendered to a point where he couldn't any longer. He became basically indigent. He was reliant on other people and on the province.
